stem.text: How many statements about semi-conservative replication of DNA in a eukaryotic cell are correct?

items: The process takes place in the cytoplasm.
An adenine nucleotide will line up against uracil on the template strand.
Each daughter molecule will contain half of the original DNA molecule.
If the DNA molecule contained 40% guanine nucleotides, each daughter molecule will contain 20% guanine nucleotides.
